item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 5 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 5 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 2:00 PM, 14 August 2026(Friday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Bataan and Zambales(Subic, Olongapo, San Marcelino, Castillejos, San Antonio, San Narciso, San Felipe, Cabangan, Botolan, Iba).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Metro Manila, Bulacan, Pampanga, Cavite(Bacoor, Imus, Noveleta, Cavite City, Kawit, Tanza, Rosario, General Trias, Trece Martires, Naic, Maragondon, Ternate, General Emilio Aguinaldo, Magallanes), Batangas(Nasugbu, Tuy, Lian, Balayan, Calatagan, Calaca), Zambales(Palauig, Masinloc, Candelaria, Santa Cruz) and Tarlac(San Clemente, Mayantoc, San Jose, Capas, Bamban).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.


Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Laguna, Tarlac(Concepcion, Anao, Tarlac City, Gerona, La Paz, Paniqui, Pura, Ramos, San Manuel, Victoria, Camiling, Moncada, Santa Ignacia) and Batangas(Alitagtag, Balete, Batangas City, Bauan, Tanauan, Cuenca, Ibaan, Lipa, Lobo, Mabini, Malvar, Mataasnakahoy, Padre Garcia, Rosario, San Jose, San Juan, San Luis, San Pascual, Santa Teresita, Santo Tomas, Talisay, Taysan, Tingloy, Taal, San Nicolas, Agoncillo, Lemery, Laurel) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Rizal, Nueva Ecija(San Jose, Pantabangan, Lupao, Carranglan), Quezon(Catanauan, Burdeos, Panukulan, Patnanungan, Tagkawayan) and Cavite(Alfonso, Amadeo, Indang, Mendez, Silang, Tagaytay, Carmona, Dasmarinas, Gen. Mariano Alvarez) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
